install.effects: Frozen pnpm 10.12.4 dependency installation from pnpm-lock.yaml; no setup, global tool change or deployment.

setup.effects: Validate rer-setup.json answers, write private .dev.vars (0600), build the Worker, apply migrations/core to .wrangler/state, start Orbit briefly, claim the first owner with the private setup token, place a sign-in link in /__dev/outbox and stop the app. Reruns keep the owner, data and settings bytes.

dev.effects: Serve Orbit through Vite with HMR on the requested loopback origin, run the minute Cron Trigger locally, request a fresh owner sign-in link and print RER_READY and RER_SIGN_IN once /health answers.

preview.effects: Serve the fixed production build with one workerd on the saved state and owner; no rebuild while serving.

build.effects: Build the production Worker and assets into dist/ with private local settings moved aside and restored exactly.

verify.effects: Run scripts/verify.mjs: source, boundary and manifest checks, D1 core and delegation suites, typecheck, built-Worker and browser journeys, the rer command journey, the capacity measurement and the fold qualification. Reports executed gates only; see ACCEPTANCE.md.

reset.effects: After explicit confirmation, remove .wrangler/state, .rer/local, .seed/installer and .dev.vars. Source, dependencies, exports and .rer/deploy receipts stay. No remote effect.

deploy.effects: Build locally, then deploy to the owner's Cloudflare account with the Base deploy kit (Worker, D1 and migrations, minute Cron, declared secrets), check /health and claim the first owner. --dry-run validates the declaration and packaged build with no provider request.

export.effects: Write a new owner-only local archive of every Orbit table through Base portability, with a content hash, row counts and exclusions (sessions, sign-in links, collaborator authority, delegation credentials, archive bookkeeping, source secrets). Remote transfer is not supported here; hosted installations use Records > Archive.

import.effects: Validate an archive, restore it atomically into an empty local database and rebuild search indexes. Run setup afterwards with the archived owner email.

release.effects: Base release producer: clean source release receipt and optional local tag; never pushes or deploys.

outbox.effects: Print the running local app's /__dev/outbox URL; --owner-email requests a fresh ordinary sign-in link.

doctor.effects: Read-only tool, version, local settings and state placement diagnostics. No provider request.

describe.effects: Describe commands, flags, aliases, effects, pins and local state without running project commands.

check.effects: Read-only structural validation of the seed command contract, aliases, pins, operations descriptor and copied Base sources.

health.meaning: Orbit reads its D1 workspace settings. It does not prove mail delivery, AI, Cron or complete workflow readiness.

environmentSources.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: The owner Cloudflare account ID for deployment, see OPERATIONS.md
environmentSources.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: An account API token with Workers Scripts and D1 edit for deployment, see OPERATIONS.md
environmentSources.OWNER_EMAIL: The setup prompt or owner email flag locally; the deploy environment when hosted, see OPERATIONS.md
environmentSources.MAIL_PROVIDER: Written by rer setup locally and set by the deploy declaration when hosted, see OPERATIONS.md
environmentSources.MAIL_FROM: Written by rer setup locally; a verified SendGrid sender in the deploy environment, see OPERATIONS.md
environmentSources.AUTH_ORIGIN: The loopback origin written by rer setup locally; the deployed origin set by the deploy kit, see OPERATIONS.md
environmentSources.SENDGRID_API_KEY: A SendGrid Mail Send API key in the deploy environment, never needed locally, see OPERATIONS.md
